data.headline: Amgen Faces Rocatinlimab Halt And Rethinks Pipeline And Capital Priorities
data.summary: Amgen (NasdaqGS:AMGN) and Kyowa Kirin have stopped all clinical trials of rocatinlimab after newly identified safety concerns.
